metadata.name: Oneko
metadata.description: Adds Oneko onto your playback bar!

files.index.css: .player-controls .playback-progressbar::before { content: ''; width: 32px; height: 32px; bottom: calc(100% - 7px); right: 10px; position: absolute; image-rendering: pixelated; background-image: url('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/adryd325/oneko.js/14bab15a755d0e35cd4ae19c931d96d306f99f42/oneko.gif'); animation: oneko 1s infinite; } @keyframes oneko { 0%, 50% { background-position: -64px 0; } 50.0001%, 100% { background-position: -64px -32px; } }
